# The test tools the image jobs mount into the final image to run the application suite there, each pinned by the
# hash of its universal wheel, and installed as wheels only (no source archive, so no code of theirs runs at install):
#     python3 -m pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary :all: --target DIR -r .github/security/image-test-requirements.txt
